entries: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. While the sword is ablaze, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} fire damage to any target it hits. The flames last until you use a bonus action to speak the command word again or until you drop or sheathe the sword.

While holding this magic weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} and use a command word to cause flames to engulf the damage-dealing part of the weapon. These flames shed {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 40-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 40 feet. While the weapon is ablaze, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Fire damage on a hit. The flames last until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to issue the command again or until you drop, stow, or sheathe the weapon.
